title: Catpilot organization overlay, version 2
description: Version 2 of the company rules file (docs/spec/OVERLAY_V2.md). Every model-facing list item is an object with a stable id and its phrase as text; an optional machine-only enforcement section holds rules that are never rendered into a prompt or returned by the server. Version 1 files are checked against overlay.schema.json instead. Cross-field rules are checked by tools/validate_overlay.py only, as in version 1: ids and aliases unique across the file, use_instead resolving to an approved item, no enforcement host in a model-facing value, the secret and content scans, and IP addresses refused as hosts. Never commit an overlay to a public repository.

organization.description: Display name only. No internal identifiers, tenant IDs, or domains.

owner.description: Where 'ask a human' points: a team mailbox, channel name, or role. One value.

intake_url.description: Optional HTTPS intake form URL for security review requests. No credentials, no query string, host on the validator's allowlist.

reviewed_on.description: Date a named reviewer accepted these values.

expires_on.description: After this date the values are treated as unknown; a private bundle cannot be built from an expired overlay.

location.description: HTTPS only, no credentials, no query string, host on the validator's allowlist. Omit if the tool cannot reach it.

enforcement.description: Machine-only. Never rendered into a prompt or returned by the server; read by hooks and the pull-request check once they ship. Validated only in this release.

default_mode.description: The mode of a rule with no mode of its own.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens. Unique across the file, aliases and enforcement rule ids included; never reused for a different thing.

phrase.description: One short phrase. No URLs, no email addresses, no secrets, no narrative, no enforcement value.

aliases.description: Former ids, matched exactly; not synonyms.

kind.description: Closed list (OVERLAY_V2.md §2.2). package_registry and cloud_account enter the schema with their first consumer.

use_instead.description: The id or an alias of an item in hosting.approved or services.approved.

branch.description: A Git branch name: no spaces, .., ~, ^, :, ?, [, \ or leading -; * only as a trailing /*, which covers the prefix.

host.description: A lowercase host name with at least one dot, optionally starting with *. to cover subdomains. No scheme, port, path, credentials or IP address.
